# Synthea test fixtures

Five synthetic patients (one deceased) generated by [Synthea](https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea), taken
from the SMART on FHIR
[sample-bulk-fhir-datasets](https://github.com/smart-on-fhir/sample-bulk-fhir-datasets) `10-patients` branch at
commit `54fa822575407ffc3255bc1d510749a28c29eb38`. Those datasets are released under
[CC0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). All data are synthetic; there is no real patient data here.

The same resources are stored in two layouts, so tests can check that both give identical MEDS output:

- `bulk/`: FHIR bulk-data export (`<Type>.000.ndjson.gz`, `Patient/<id>` references).
- `bundles/`: one transaction Bundle per patient (`<patient id>.json.gz`, `urn:uuid:<id>` references), the layout of
    Synthea's default FHIR exporter.

Changes from the source data:

- Only the selected patients' resources are kept, plus two `AllergyIntolerance`s that reference patients missing
    from the export (a quirk of the source dataset), to exercise dropping orphaned resources.
- Base64 clinical notes (`DiagnosticReport.presentedForm`, `DocumentReference.content.attachment.data`) are removed.
- `Location`, `Organization`, `Practitioner` and `PractitionerRole` are not included.

Note that `EpisodeOfCare`, `ServiceRequest`, `Specimen` and `MedicationDispense` in the source are added by the
SMART generation script, not by Synthea itself.

Regenerate with:

```bash
python scripts/make_synthea_fixtures.py tests/fixtures/synthea
```
